prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic cinematic fashion portrait of an adult woman standing playfully and leaning slightly forward in an outdoor garden at night, smiling warmly and confidently at camera. She has long loose blonde hair, wears a soft white fabric bunny-ear headband, a light-pink satin crop top with thin straps, form-fitting iridescent metallic-pink high-waisted shorts, a small transparent handbag and a fluffy bunny-tail detail. The setting includes flowers, bushes and glowing street lamps in a park with decorative lighting. Use direct flash balanced with warm yellow lamps and pink accent lighting, cinematic glow, soft highlights on skin, vibrant contrast, portrait-lens shallow depth of field and natural realism. Keep the adult fashion-editorial context and avoid sexualized framing.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, childlike appearance, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, transparent clothing, distorted handbag, duplicated tail
